instruction: Recover highlight details from the RAW file and export as BMP.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because recovering highlight details from RAW files relies on the extra dynamic range stored in RAW format's high bit-depth data (typically 12-14 bits per channel). The file 'yicun.raw' is a JPEG with only 8 bits per channel and lossy compression. Clipped highlights in a JPEG (pure white, 255,255,255) contain no recoverable detail - the data is permanently lost. While RAW files often have recoverable detail in highlights due to their linear encoding and higher bit depth, this JPEG has already applied gamma correction and compression, making highlight recovery as specified in the task impossible.
